description:
Why Brush Teeth at Night? — You ate 3 gummies before bed and skipped brushing—look who wakes up at 2 AM!
Kids science answer for "why brush teeth at night for kids" with fun 2D animation by BabyBeats Rhymo!

Saliva slows down at bedtime while mouth bacteria eat leftover sugar and release acid that slowly wears away strong tooth enamel.
